adventures-wanderlust.title: Georgia - 07/10/2012
adventures-wanderlust.description:
These are buildings on the outskirts of Tbilisi. Remnants from the Soviet Union with fairly brutal architecture.
Tbilisi is a city of a lot of contrasts. Old and new, rich and poor. The center is absolutely marvellous and a tourist delight. It has nothing to envy to parts of Paris or Istanbul and is a really nice place to visit. Great outdoor spaces and terraces, fountains, really good restaurants, nice bars, and old town and a newer part of town, interesting architecture, a lot of history, etc. 
But then, on the outskirts, it can quickly become ghetto like. The soviet era buildings can be quite lugubrious and actually a bit scary.
Tbilisi is never the less a jewel in Eurasia and deserves to be visited.
adventures-wanderlust.metadata: Date taken: 07/10/2012 16:20 • Camera: Canon EOS 7D • F-stop: f/11 • Exposure time: 1/400s • ISO Speed: 400 • Focal length: 400mm
